findings.current: Baeksang’s trembling eyes passed over his white robes, burning away beneath the heat, and then over my calm face.
findings.defect: The draft makes Baeksang deliberately look over the robes and Taekyung’s face, whereas the source describes those images passing across or being reflected in Baeksang’s trembling eyes.
findings.rationale: The subject of 스친다 is the images of the robes and Taekyung’s face, not Baeksang’s gaze.
findings.replacement: In Baeksang’s trembling eyes, his burning white robes and my calm face appeared in turn.
findings.source: 파르르 떨리는 백상의 눈동자에, 타들어 가는 그의 새하얀 옷자락과 담담한 내 얼굴이 차례대로 스친다.

findings.current: I twisted Baeksang’s wrist to the side, locking out his other hand while disrupting his balance. At the same time, I drove my remaining palm into his flank.
findings.defect: The draft makes the palm strike simultaneous with the wrist control, but the source explicitly places it afterward, once Baeksang’s other hand has been sealed and his balance disrupted.
findings.rationale: 다음 establishes a sequence: control the wrists and balance first, then deliver the palm strike.
findings.replacement: I twisted Baeksang’s wrist aside, simultaneously pinning his other hand and throwing him off balance. Then I struck his flank with my free palm.
findings.source: 백상의 손목을 옆으로 틀어 다른 한 손을 봉함과 동시에 중심을 흐트린 다음, 남은 한 손으로 옆구리를 향해 일장(一掌).

findings.current: Even if I gave myself every benefit of the doubt and admitted that I might have caused the problem in the first place, the attack Baeksang had used had been dangerous enough to kill me.
findings.defect: “Gave myself every benefit of the doubt” means interpreting the situation in Taekyung’s own favor, the opposite of 백번 양보해서, which means conceding the point as generously as possible to the other side.
findings.rationale: Taekyung is conditionally conceding his own responsibility while stressing that Baeksang escalated with a potentially lethal attack.
findings.replacement: Even if I conceded that I might have started the whole thing, Baeksang’s attack had still been dangerous enough to kill me.
findings.source: 백번 양보해서 문제의 발단은 나였을지 몰라도, 백상이 펼친 수는 자칫하면 절명에 이를 수 있는 위험한 공격이었다.

findings.current: And before everyone’s eyes, an indelible blemish had been carved into Baeksang’s standing and reputation.
findings.defect: The established rendering of 명성 is “Fame,” but the draft substitutes “reputation.” It also strengthens 쉽게 지울 수 없는, “not easily erased,” into the absolute “indelible.”
findings.rationale: This preserves the binding terminology and the source’s qualified description of how difficult the damage will be to erase.
findings.replacement: And before everyone’s eyes, Baeksang’s standing and Fame had suffered a blemish that would not be easily erased.
findings.source: 그리고 모두가 지켜보는 앞에서 백상의 위상과 명성에는 쉽게 지울 수 없는 흠집이 새겨졌다.

findings.current: Because of that curiosity, you made more than a hundred thousand members of the Bai people your enemies.
findings.defect: The draft multiplies the quantity by ten: 일만이 넘는 means more than ten thousand, not more than one hundred thousand.
findings.replacement: Because of that curiosity, you made more than ten thousand members of the Bai people your enemies.
findings.source: 그 호기심 때문에 넌 일만이 넘는 백족을 적으로 만들었다.

findings.current: Tonight, we will erect a memorial stele for those who were sacrificed and hold a banquet in their honor.
findings.defect: “Those who were sacrificed” suggests that the victims were deliberately offered as sacrifices, which the source does not say.
findings.rationale: 희생당한 이들 refers to people who fell victim or died, not to people ritually sacrificed.
findings.replacement: Tonight, we will erect a memorial stele for those who lost their lives and hold a banquet in their honor.
findings.source: 오늘 밤. 희생당한 이들을 위한 위령비를 세우고 그들을 위한 연회를 열 것이다.

findings.current: “Elder Namho! How dare you take our Captain for!”
findings.defect: The line is ungrammatical, and “Elder Namho” makes Hyuk Mujin sound respectful even though 남 노인 is his indignant, insulting “old man Nam” address.
findings.rationale: The replacement restores both the missing English construction and the established hostile register between Hyuk Mujin and Namho.
findings.replacement: “Look here, old man Nam! What do you take our Captain for?”
findings.source: “이보시오. 남 노인! 감히 우리 조장님을 뭘로 보고!”

findings.current: “Pavilion Master, say something too. So, did you decide to join the alliance?”
findings.defect: The draft makes Taekyung the person deciding whether to join the alliance. Ju Hwaran is asking whether Nanman’s decision to join has been reached.
findings.rationale: The ongoing objective is to secure the Nanman Beast Palace’s entry into the Murim Alliance; Taekyung himself is already an Alliance representative.
findings.replacement: “Pavilion Master, say something too. So, have they decided to join the alliance?”
findings.source: “각주님도 뭐라고 한 말씀 해 보세요. 그래서, 입맹하기로 한 건가요?”

findings.current:
“Did you kill him?”

“No.”

“Then you hit him.”
findings.defect: The draft invents a specific male target before Taekyung has identified anyone, removing the source’s deliberate ambiguity about what sort of incident occurred.
findings.rationale: Korean permits the object to remain unstated here, and Namho does not begin guessing the target’s identity until the following lines.
findings.replacement:
“Did you kill someone?”

“No.”

“Then you beat someone up.”

findings.current: Namho chuckled warmly and opened his mouth.
findings.defect: “Warmly” adds an affectionate tone absent from the source and clashes with the mocking punchline that follows.
findings.rationale: 허허 웃으며 indicates a chuckle, while the context supplies mockery rather than warmth.

summary: Several actionable fidelity issues alter combat mechanics, quantities, speaker register, and the subject of the alliance decision.
